name: maxio-sdk-merged
description: Install and consume the Maxio Advanced Billing .NET SDK, grounded in a bundled SDK map. A single maxio-sdk agent plans a map-grounded contract sheet, answers narrow contract questions, and fixes SDK compile/build errors in place — cloning the SDK source only when the map cannot settle a fact. Includes the integrate-maxio router and the map-grounded maxio-sdk agent. No MCP server.
